name: Procurement Reviews
description: The Monday procurement review an agent writes from the records above: spend at risk, every red supplier, every contract coming up.

body.en: Read the `busa-suppliers` skill in this folder and follow it. Write the procurement review for last Monday to Sunday from the suppliers, signals and actions: a one-line headline, spend at risk and how it changed, every at-risk supplier with its cause and action, watch suppliers whose contract ends in the next 90 days, and what changed since last week. Save it as a draft.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-suppliers` Skill，按它的规则做。根据供应商、信号和改进措施，写上周一到周日的采购周报：一句话结论、有风险的采购额及变化、每家有风险供应商的原因和改进措施、未来 90 天内合同到期的关注供应商、与上周相比的变化。保存为草稿。

label.en: What got better or worse since last week?
label.zh-CN: 和上周比哪些变好了、哪些变差了

body.en: Read the `busa-suppliers` skill in this folder and follow it. Compare the two latest reviews and the signals between them: which suppliers changed rating, how spend at risk moved, and which actions closed. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-suppliers` Skill，按它的规则做。对比最近两份周报和期间的信号：哪些供应商换了评级、有风险的采购额怎么变、哪些改进措施完成了。不要修改任何记录。
